item: owner closure item 3 — audit/question-identity-proposals.jsonl must not be left unexplained
determination: an intentionally local review list, now declared as one
whatItIs: backfill-analysis.mjs offers questions its hole-detector found; one the registry does not know is given no identity and no row, and the proposal is recorded here for review
notEmpty: both Gate 2 live exports recorded 54 proposals, byte-identical (16,945 bytes, sha256 46d7f2eecf6eba7ce3b8daf95e8f87dd36a3f83f1db1c000a0bed145374fdf2a), so 'remove it when empty' would not have applied — that behaviour already existed and is preserved

theRealProblem.finding: the file was untracked AND unignored, and preflight-deploy.mjs judges the tree with `git status --porcelain`, which counts untracked files
theRealProblem.consequence: the first genuine export in a long while would have left a tree that refuses to publish, over a file holding no certified data
theRealProblem.whyUnseen: deploys were going out under SKIP_EXPORT — the rebuild path proposes none, so the file never appeared

resolution: the path is gitignored with the reasoning recorded in .gitignore; the run's own stdout keeps the signal ('54 proposed question(s) were NOT written to questions.json'), and the file itself remains readable when the owner wants it
notDone: the 54 proposals are untouched and remain for the owner to adjudicate; none of them reaches questions.json, which is byte-identical to the certified baseline on both export paths

regressionCoverage.registeredIn: validate.mjs — 'the proposals review list cannot go stale or block a deploy'
covers: the path is gitignored and untracked, so it can never dirty a tree or refuse a deploy
preflight still counts untracked files, so the ignore is what protects the release
driving the real resolver against a temporary root: a run proposing nothing deletes a list an earlier run left
a run proposing something writes one parseable JSON line per proposal, naming the step and saying the row was not written
an unregistered proposal is still given no identity of any kind
the run reports what it declined to write and names where it recorded it

verifiedAfterTheChain: a rebuild proposes none and the file is absent from the worktree
